annotation.title_clean: 中华人民共和国审计法实施条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations for the Implementation of the Audit Law of the People's Republic of China
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Decree No. 847 promulgating the revised Regulations for the Implementation of China's Audit Law, effective 1 December 2026. It sets out the powers, procedures, jurisdiction and legal liabilities of audit authorities over public finance and state-owned entities. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Second revision of the 1997 Audit Law implementing regulations, effective 1 December 2026.
Defines audit authorities' responsibilities over budget execution, state-owned enterprises, public projects and social funds.
Sets audit procedures, including notice, report, review, decision and rectification follow-up.
Specifies penalties and remedies, including fines, referral, administrative reconsideration and litigation.
Encourages use of big data and information technology in auditing.
